parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
archaic[a:rkeiik]adj.
If something is archaic, it is very old or outdated.
→ To be competitive, we must update our archaic equipment.
😎
benevolent[bənevələnt]adj.
If someone is benevolent, they are kind and generous.
→ My father was a benevolent man and gave lots of money to charity.
😎
brass[bræs]n.
Brass is a metal that is used to make musical instruments and ornaments.
→ Brass is used to make musical instruments like trumpets.
😎
capitalism[kæpitəlizəm]n.
Capitalism is an economic system where private companies make goods for profit.
→ Most industries in the world today are based on capitalism.
😎
component[kəmpounənt]n.
A component is a part of a larger machine.
→ Computers have many different components, so they are complicated to build.
😎
dependence[dipendəns]n.
Dependence is a situation in which somebody relies on something else.
→ Young children have a dependence on their parents.
😎
diminish[dəminiʃ]v.
To diminish means to reduce or get smaller.
→ As the economy got worse, my savings diminished.
😎
drawback[drɔ:bæk]n.
A drawback is a disadvantage.
→ The drawback of having a car is that it is very expensive to maintain.
😎
fad[fæd]n.
A fad is something that is popular for a short time.
→ The hula hoop was a fad for a few years, but it soon lost its popularity.
😎
impose[impouz]v.
To impose means to interrupt or force your ideas on other people.
→ He imposes on his wife every morning by expecting her to make breakfast.
😎
managerial[mænədʒiəriəl]adj.
Managerial describes something related to a manager or management.
→ Nancy has a managerial position at the bank.
😎
medieval[mi:dii:vəl]adj.
If something is medieval, it comes from the period between 650 and 1500 CE.
→ We visited a castle that was built during medieval times.
😎
obsolete[absəli:t]adj.
If something is obsolete, it is not used anymore because something better exists.
→ Since computers became inexpensive, typewriters have become obsolete.
😎
peninsula[pəninsələ]n.
A peninsula is a large piece of land that is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
→ The state of Florida is an example of a peninsula.
😎
prestige[presti:ʒ]n.
If a person has prestige, people admire or respect them.
→ The young actress gained much prestige after she won an award.
😎
proportion[prəpɔ:rʃən]n.
A proportion is an amount that shows the link between the parts and the whole.
→ Only a small proportion of the people in this town actually work here.
😎
radical[rædikəl]adj.
If something is radical, it is very new or different.
→ The president is planning to make some radical changes to the law.
😎
refute[rifju:t]v.
To refute something means to prove that it is false or incorrect.
→ The bank manager has refuted the claims that he lied to his customers.
😎
spectacular[spektækjələr]adj.
If something is spectacular, it looks or sounds very impressive.
→ There was a spectacular fireworks display in the park at New Year.
😎
weave[wi:v]v.
To weave means to make cloth using horizontal and vertical threads.
→ We saw a woman weave a blanket on our vacation to South America.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What is something that is archaic?
questions.explanation: archaic nghĩa là cổ xưa/lỗi thời; Kim tự tháp Ai Cập (Egyptian pyramid) là một thứ cổ xưa.

questions.content: Which of these things is often made of brass?
questions.explanation: brass là đồng thau, thường dùng làm nhạc cụ như kèn saxophone.

questions.content: Which of these is a component in a radio?
questions.explanation: component là thành phần/linh kiện; dây điện (wires) là một linh kiện của radio.

questions.content: Which of these things could be seen during the medieval ages?
questions.explanation: medieval (thời trung cổ) thì có lâu đài (castles).

questions.content: If you are on a small peninsula, you will be quite near to ______
questions.explanation: peninsula (bán đảo) là dải đất nhô ra biển, nên bạn sẽ ở gần biển (the sea).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: weave
questions.explanation: weave là dệt/kết lại, trái nghĩa với to pull apart (kéo rời ra/tháo ra).

questions.content: managerial
questions.explanation: managerial là thuộc về quản lý (cấp cao), trái nghĩa với entry-level (cấp thấp/mới vào làm).

questions.content: prestige
questions.explanation: prestige là uy tín/thanh thế, trái nghĩa với lowliness (sự thấp kém/hèn mọn).

questions.content: drawback
questions.explanation: drawback là khuyết điểm/bất lợi, trái nghĩa với benefit (lợi ích). (Lưu ý: sách in đáp án là C - disadvantage nhưng đó là từ đồng nghĩa, từ trái nghĩa đúng là B).

questions.content: obsolete
questions.explanation: obsolete là lỗi thời, trái nghĩa với innovative (tân tiến/đổi mới).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the one that is SIMILAR in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: benevolent
questions.explanation: benevolent (nhân từ/tốt bụng) đồng nghĩa với kind.

questions.content: diminish
questions.explanation: diminish (giảm bớt) đồng nghĩa với decrease.

questions.content: radical
questions.explanation: radical (mang tính căn bản, hoàn toàn mới lạ) đồng nghĩa với new.

questions.content: spectacular
questions.explanation: spectacular (ngoạn mục/đẹp mắt) đồng nghĩa với amazing.

questions.content: fad
questions.explanation: fad (mốt nhất thời) đồng nghĩa với trend (xu hướng).

sections.title: Exercise 4: Check if the italicized word is used correctly.

questions.content: Knights in armor and their squires were common sites in medieval times.
questions.explanation: medieval (thời trung cổ) phù hợp với kỵ sĩ và áo giáp (Knights in armor).

questions.content: Our new boss hasn't made any changes to the company. He has very radical ideas.
questions.explanation: radical (căn bản/đổi mới hoàn toàn), nhưng vế trước lại nói 'hasn't made any changes' là mâu thuẫn.

questions.content: I don't want to impose on my father to help me with my homework. He's very busy.
questions.explanation: impose on someone (áp đặt/làm phiền ai đó), câu này dùng chính xác.

questions.content: He refuted me because I didn't wash the plates after dinner.
questions.explanation: refute (bác bỏ/chứng minh là sai), không hợp nghĩa với việc 'vì tôi không rửa bát'.

questions.content: In capitalism, people can own just about any product or object they want.
questions.explanation: capitalism (chủ nghĩa tư bản), người dân có thể sở hữu sản phẩm họ muốn là đúng ý nghĩa.

sections.title: Exercise 5: Choose the word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: Our hotel was situated on a <u>piece of land that was surrounded by the sea on three sides</u>.
questions.explanation: Một dải đất có 3 mặt giáp biển gọi là bán đảo (peninsula).

questions.content: Doctors say the exercise can <u>reduce</u> the chances of getting ill.
questions.explanation: Làm giảm đi (reduce) tương đương với diminish.

questions.content: Children's <u>reliance</u> on their parents decreases as they get older.
questions.explanation: Sự phụ thuộc (reliance) tương đương với dependence.

questions.content: There are a number of <u>disadvantages</u> to taking up this new technology.
questions.explanation: Nhược điểm (disadvantages) tương đương với drawbacks.

questions.content: A large <u>amount</u> of students from my school want to go to university.
questions.explanation: Một lượng lớn (amount/tỷ lệ) học sinh tương đương với proportion.

questions.content: I need to buy some new <u>parts</u> for my computer to make it work properly.
questions.explanation: Các bộ phận (parts) tương đương với components.

questions.content: I'm sorry to <u>interrupt and intrude</u> on you, but I need some help with my car.
questions.explanation: Cắt ngang và làm phiền (interrupt and intrude) tương đương với impose.

questions.content: The newspaper editor <u>disproved</u> the claim that the stories in the paper were untrue.
questions.explanation: Bác bỏ/chứng minh là sai (disproved) tương đương với refuted.

questions.content: The show at the theater was <u>very impressive</u>.
questions.explanation: Rất ấn tượng (very impressive) tương đương với spectacular.

questions.content: The <u>kind and generous</u> women gave lots of money to help the poor.
questions.explanation: Tốt bụng và hào phóng (kind and generous) tương đương với benevolent.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Weaving Machine

Mr. Joseph Franklin invented a machine that could weave cloth. It wove faster and straighter than anyone could weave by hand. He decided to take it to two cities on a peninsula, Netherton and Wilton. In these cities, a large proportion of the people worked in weaving. Joseph felt sure he could sell his machine there.

Joseph first took his machine to the mayor of Netherton. "Think of the money you will earn from this machine!" Joseph said to him.

But the mayor was a benevolent man. He knew about the people's dependence on weaving for their livelihood. If he bought the machine, the people would lose their jobs. So he refused to buy it.

Joseph said, "We are no longer in the medieval age! Soon everything will be made by machines. Cloth made by hand will soon be obsolete. If you don't change your archaic ways, your town's income will diminish!"

But the mayor said, "I don't like capitalism. Don't impose your radical ideas on my town. Go away!"

So Joseph took his machine to the mayor at Wilton. This mayor thought Joseph's machine was spectacular and spent a long time looking at its different components made of brass. The mayor couldn't refute the fact that the machine had drawbacks that would affect the people's jobs. But he realized the machine could bring money and prestige. So he ordered Joseph to build twenty of them.

Within a year, Wilton was a wealthy city, famous for its wonderful cloth. People no longer wove but worked in managerial jobs at cloth factories instead. Nobody bought the cloth from Netherton anymore. The people of Netherton became poor and hungry.

Finally, the mayor of Netherton called Joseph and said, "Now I realize that your machine is not just a passing fad. To succeed in business, we must be willing to change." He then ordered twenty weaving machines.

After that, both Netherton and Wilton became rich cities, famous throughout the land for their wonderful cloth.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: The mayor of Netherton wanted Joseph to impose his radical fad on the town.
questions.explanation: Thị trưởng Netherton yêu cầu Joseph đừng áp đặt (don't impose) những ý tưởng mới mẻ nhưng khác biệt (radical ideas) lên thị trấn của ông, chứ không phải muốn ông ta áp đặt. Nhận định này sai.

questions.content: Joseph thought the mayor of Netherton's ideas were medieval and archaic.
questions.explanation: Joseph thẳng thừng nói với thị trưởng Netherton rằng chúng ta không còn ở thời trung cổ (medieval age) nữa và khuyên ông nên thay đổi những cách thức cổ hủ (archaic ways) đó đi. Vậy nhận định là đúng.

questions.content: The mayor of Wilton refuted the fact that the machine had drawbacks.
questions.explanation: Thị trưởng Wilton không thể bác bỏ (couldn't refute) việc cái máy này có khuyết điểm sẽ làm ảnh hưởng đến công việc của người dân. Vì vậy câu nói ông ấy đã bác bỏ (refuted) là sai.

questions.content: In Wilton, the people who used to weave got managerial positions at the factories.
questions.explanation: Bài viết ghi rõ người dân không còn dệt vải nữa mà thay vào đó làm các công việc quản lý (managerial jobs) tại nhà máy. Nhận định này hoàn toàn chính xác.

questions.content: In the end, capitalism brought prestige to both cities.
questions.explanation: Đến cuối cùng, hệ thống kinh tế hướng tới lợi nhuận mới đã giúp cả hai thành phố trở nên giàu có và nổi tiếng khắp nơi (mang lại prestige). Do đó nhận định này là đúng.

questions.content: What job did a large proportion of the people on the peninsula do?
questions.explanation: Một tỷ lệ lớn người dân ở hai thành phố trên bán đảo làm nghề dệt vải (worked in weaving). Đáp án đúng là B.

questions.content: According to Joseph, what will soon be obsolete?
questions.explanation: Theo Joseph, những mảnh vải được làm thủ công bằng tay (cloth made by hand) sẽ sớm trở nên lỗi thời (obsolete) vì máy móc sẽ làm mọi thứ. Chọn đáp án C.

questions.content: What did the benevolent mayor of Netherton realize about the people's dependence on weaving?
options: If he bought the machine, the people would lose their jobs.
questions.explanation: Vị thị trưởng nhân từ nhận ra sự phụ thuộc của người dân vào nghề dệt, và ông biết rằng nếu ông mua cái máy đó, người dân sẽ mất việc (lose their jobs). Ta chọn đáp án A.

questions.content: What did the mayor of Wilton realize about the spectacular machine with components made of brass?
options: He realized the machine could bring money and prestige.
questions.explanation: Mặc dù chiếc máy có khuyết điểm (làm mất việc), thị trưởng Wilton vẫn nhận ra rằng nó có thể mang lại tiền bạc và danh tiếng (money and prestige) cho thành phố. Chọn đáp án C.

questions.content: Why did income diminish in Netherton after machines were introduced in Wilton?
options: Because they ran out of thread.
Nobody bought the cloth from Netherton anymore.
questions.explanation: Nguồn thu nhập bị thu hẹp đi là do không còn ai mua vải từ Netherton nữa (Nobody bought the cloth from Netherton anymore). Do đó đáp án B là hợp lý.
